# Asphalt 02

Texture by **Rob Tuytel**, downloaded from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02).
License: [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), independently verified on the [official asset page](https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02) and [Poly Haven asset license page](https://polyhaven.com/license) on 23 October 2026. CC0 permits use, modification and redistribution, including commercial use; attribution is appreciated but not required.

Files are the original, unmodified **1024 × 1024** JPG downloads from Poly Haven's official API/CDN:

- `asphalt-diffuse.jpg` — diffuse color, 731,707 bytes. Use sRGB color space.
- `asphalt-normal.jpg` — **OpenGL** tangent-space normal, 1,240,122 bytes. Use linear/no color conversion, not DirectX green-channel inversion.

Original surface covers a 3-metre-wide square. The diffuse and normal maps must use matching UV repeats. The official API file sizes and MD5 checksums were verified against both downloaded files; URLs, SHA-256 and verification details are in `asphalt-source.json`. No model or texture was generated for these assets.
